scope: Content-free Live synchronization diagnostics without changing connection, retry, recording or fair-play behavior

incident.observed: One opponent update was not shown during an own Dev game; a later browser move made the application catch up
incident.cause: Unconfirmed: the existing Debug log did not trace individual provider updates or Live revision acceptance

events.gameStreamAvailableMeaning: First game event received, not a separate HTTP handshake assertion
events.report: Counters retained; external identifiers and content remain excluded

coverage: Account and game retries, complete history reception and published revision
Own and observed EOF completion and saving with a throwing diagnostic callback
Renderer event receipt, superseded reads, stale revisions, read failure and safe recovery
Throwing renderer diagnostic sink cannot alter acceptance or fair-play safety
Closed IPC, raw log and redacted report allowlists reject content and invalid counters
Real isolated Host composition writes the trace with an in-memory provider
Existing Live recording, provider transport, clocks, privacy, API, MCP and event contracts

limits: No real-account reproduction, full-suite or native UI acceptance claim
No names, tokens, URLs, external game IDs, moves, FEN or provider error text in the trace
No extra reads, retry policy, polling, clock ticks or visible UI messaging
No real credentials, account actions, manual user process restart or user data changes
No schema migration, product version change, commit, push or release
